title: Write unit tests for untested date utility
description: A small date-utility module (addBusinessDays, isWeekend, formatShortDate) has no test coverage at all. Write a thorough unit test suite covering typical inputs, weekend/holiday boundary conditions, and invalid input handling, without modifying the module's implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Each exported function has direct unit tests covering at least one typical case and at least one boundary case.
addBusinessDays is tested across a range that crosses at least one weekend.
Invalid inputs (e.g. non-Date arguments) are tested for their actual current behavior, not an assumed behavior.
The new test suite achieves full line coverage of the utility module.
No production code in the utility module is modified.
verificationMethod: test-suite: run the new test file and confirm it passes against the unmodified module, plus a coverage check confirming full line coverage of the module.
groundTruth: A complete test file exercises every exported function against representative and boundary inputs, asserting on the module's actual current output rather than idealized expected behavior, since the task is coverage, not a behavior fix.
